fixtures:
  customer.alice:
    type: CUSTOMER
    customerNumber: TEST-C0001
    displayName: 测试客户甲
    kycStatus: APPROVED
    logicalAccounts:
      primarySavings: account.alice.primarySavings

  customer.bob:
    type: CUSTOMER
    customerNumber: TEST-C0002
    displayName: 测试客户乙
    kycStatus: APPROVED
    logicalAccounts:
      primarySavings: account.bob.primarySavings

  account.alice.primarySavings:
    type: SAVINGS_ACCOUNT
    currency: CNY
    initialBalance: "100000.00"
    fineractProductId: 1

  account.bob.primarySavings:
    type: SAVINGS_ACCOUNT
    currency: CNY
    initialBalance: "50000.00"
    fineractProductId: 1

  transfer.internal.small:
    type: TRANSFER
    sourceRef: account.alice.primarySavings
    destinationRef: account.bob.primarySavings
    amount:
      currency: CNY
      value: "100.00"
    expectedStatus: SETTLED

  loan.application.basic:
    type: LOAN_APPLICATION
    customerRef: customer.alice
    amount:
      currency: CNY
      value: "5000.00"
    termMonths: 12
    purpose: 测试贷款
    expectedScore: 94
